mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.use_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.nickname FROM post_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.board_type = 'F' AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.use_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.nickname FROM post_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.board_type = 'F' AND c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comments (board_type, post_id, user_id, content) VALUES ('F', #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post_comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE board_type = 'F' AND id = #{id}
UPDATE post_comments SET use_yn = 'N', updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE board_type = 'F' AND id = #{id}
